parameters.query:
with event_insert as (
  insert into consulting.webhook_events (
    provider,
    event_name,
    external_id,
    payload,
    processed_at
  )
  values (
    'wompi',
    $1,
    $2,
    $3::jsonb,
    now()
  )
  on conflict (provider, external_id) do update set
    payload = excluded.payload,
    processed_at = now()
  returning id
),
payment_update as (
  update consulting.payments
  set
    wompi_transaction_id = $2,
    status = $4,
    payment_method_type = $5,
    status_message = $6,
    raw_payload = $3::jsonb,
    updated_at = now()
  where wompi_reference = $7
  returning id, booking_id
),
booking_update as (
  update consulting.bookings
  set
    wompi_transaction_id = $2,
    status = $8,
    paid_at = case when $8 = 'paid' then coalesce(paid_at, now()) else paid_at end,
    cancelled_at = case when $8 = 'cancelled' then coalesce(cancelled_at, now()) else cancelled_at end,
    updated_at = now()
  where wompi_reference = $7
  returning id, lead_id, status, starts_at, ends_at, duration_hours, amount_in_cents, currency, meet_url
)
select
  (select id from event_insert limit 1) as webhook_event_id,
  (select id from payment_update limit 1) as payment_id,
  booking_update.id as booking_id,
  booking_update.lead_id,
  booking_update.status,
  booking_update.starts_at,
  booking_update.ends_at,
  booking_update.duration_hours,
  booking_update.amount_in_cents,
  booking_update.currency,
  booking_update.meet_url
from booking_update;
